# Bundled OCR runtime

This directory is generated by `node scripts/vendor-tesseract-ocr.mjs`.
Do not edit the generated runtime assets by hand.

## Sources

- Tesseract.js 5.0.4 (Apache-2.0): https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js/v/5.0.4
- tesseract.js-core 5.0.0 (Apache-2.0): https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js-core/v/5.0.0
- eng, deu, fra, spa, ita and por language packages 1.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

The language files are the `4.0.0_best_int` models used by Tesseract.js 5
for its default LSTM-only mode. They are integerized derivatives of
tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best. The language NPM packages declare MIT; the
upstream tessdata_best data is Apache-2.0. See `licenses/`.

Only the four documented v5 core loader variants are included. Their WASM is
embedded in the `.wasm.js` files, so separate duplicate `.wasm` files are
not required by the browser runtime.
